environment: **Organization**: None — single personal user (James Weitz, PICU clinician) on two Macs. Repo-specific rules and data boundaries live in each repo's CLAUDE.md; follow those
**Repository visibility**: every repo under github.com/weitzjb is private
**Source control**: github.com/weitzjb and every repo under it (cloned to ~/git/*), plus the chezmoi dotfiles source repo — all James's own
**Trusted repo**: the working repo and its origin remote, plus all of github.com/weitzjb. Confidential non-personal material is fine to commit to them; credentials and patient-level data never are

**Secrets management**: 1Password (`op` CLI and the 1Password SSH agent), resolved at connection time and never read into the session or written to disk; per-repo `.env`, `.Renviron`, `credentials.json`, `token.json` files are gitignored, never committed, never displayed

**Network posture**: Trust clinical databases (Medicus, CareVue/ICIP, PICaNet) are reachable only over the Trust VPN, and only through each clinical repo's own connection code as its CLAUDE.md describes

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: patient-level clinical data of any kind (names, MRNs, DOB, free text, clinical detail) and its identifiable exports — stays within the Trust systems and destinations each clinical repo's CLAUDE.md names, never copied into a repo or anywhere external
**Org-specific CLIs**: chezmoi (dotfiles sync across both Macs); `op` (1Password)
allow: Deleting dailyAssistant's docs/*.pdf after delivery is allowed: they are gitignored build artifacts regenerated from the .md source
